app.name: Spotify
app.description: A digital music, podcast, and video streaming service that provides access to millions of songs and other content from creators worldwide.

notes: Tested: a custom auth config created without `oauth_redirect_uri` sends `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`. Register exactly the URI your auth config sends, or set `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` and register that instead.
Composio does not provide a default OAuth app for Spotify, requiring you to create your own app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Default scopes requested by Composio cover playback control, library reading, and profile access.
Ensure your custom OAuth credentials are properly linked to avoid mismatch errors during the redirect callback.

assumption: An AI agent that accesses and manages a user's Spotify playback, playlists, and library on behalf of multiple users in production.

verdict.headline: Spotify requires a strict partner review and an established service with 250k+ MAUs for production scale.
verdict.summary: Development begins instantly via self-serve registration in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, but apps are strictly capped at 5 test users and require a Spotify Premium account. Production access is heavily gated by a May 2025 policy requiring a minimum of 250,000 monthly active users and a business entity. Getting extended access takes up to 6 weeks of review.

handsOnEffort.label: 1–2 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: App registration and basic configuration in the Spotify Developer Dashboard take minimal time.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 15–30 min
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Immediate access for development mode upon creating an app and allowlisting your Spotify Premium account.

timeToProduction.label: 2–6 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Spotify states the review process can take up to six weeks for extended quota approval.

verdict.longestPole: Meeting the strict 250,000 monthly active user requirement and passing the manual partner review process.
verdict.costDetail: A Spotify Premium account is required for the app owner and test users in Development Mode.

easierPaths.condition: Remaining under 5 allowlisted users in Development Mode
easierPaths.effect: Avoids the mandatory 250k MAU extended quota review entirely.

factors.detail: Developers can instantly create a client ID via the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Production extended quota requires a manual partner application review.
Extended Quota Mode is restricted to established business entities.
No explicit third-party security audit or technical penetration test is mandated beyond standard terms of service compliance.
App owners and test users must have a Spotify Premium account during development.
Extended quota access requires an active launched service with at least 250,000 monthly active users.
Development Mode apps are strictly capped at 5 allowlisted users.
Standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow handles user connections without enterprise tenant configurations.

phases.title: Register Your Spotify App
phases.outcome: A registered Spotify developer application with a unique Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Create a Spotify Developer Account and App
steps.details: Go to the **Spotify Developer Dashboard** (`https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard`), log in with your Spotify Premium account, click **Create an App**, fill in the App Name and App Description, accept the terms of service, and click **Create**.
steps.agentAssist: Can draft the app name and description copy.

phases.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
phases.outcome: Redirect URIs explicitly whitelisted for handling OAuth callbacks.

steps.title: Add Redirect URIs
steps.details: In your app dashboard, go to **Settings** and add your redirect URIs (e.g., `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`) under **Redirect URIs**, then click **Save**.
steps.agentAssist: Can generate the exact list of redirect URIs required for Composio integration.

phases.title: Test with Your Own Account
phases.outcome: Successful OAuth flow completion and API calls within Development Mode limits.

steps.title: Add Test Users
steps.details: Navigate to the **User Management** tab in your app's dashboard settings and manually add up to 5 authorized Spotify Premium accounts to allowlist them for Development Mode testing.
steps.agentAssist: Can generate a guide on how users should provide their Spotify email addresses for allowlisting.

phases.title: Prepare for Review
phases.outcome: Partner application readiness for Extended Quota Mode production access.

steps.title: Gather Business Metrics and Requirements
steps.details: Ensure your service is an established business entity operating an active, launched application with a minimum of 250,000 monthly active users (MAUs) and commercial viability in key markets.
steps.agentAssist: Can structure your product metrics summary and compliance checklists.

steps.title: Submit Partner Application
steps.details: Submit the official Google Form application linked in the Spotify documentation for extended Web API access.
steps.agentAssist: Can draft responses detailing your use case and technical integration scope.

phases.title: Review and Wait
phases.outcome: Partner application approval and unlocked quota extension request settings.

steps.title: Wait for Spotify Review
steps.details: Spotify evaluates the partner application to verify business standing and MAU thresholds. Once approved, request a quota extension inside the Developer Dashboard under **Settings → Quota extension Request tab**.
steps.agentAssist: Can track check-in intervals and follow-up templates.

phases.title: Go Live in Composio
phases.outcome: Spotify fully integrated as a custom toolkit provider in Composio.

steps.title: Create Custom OAuth2 Auth Config in Composio
steps.details: Use the Composio API or dashboard to create a custom OAuth2 auth config for `spotify`. Provide your Spotify app's **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
steps.agentAssist: Can automate the creation of the custom auth config via API calls using your Composio API key.

steps.title: Configure Default Scopes and Redirects in Composio
steps.details: Ensure Composio requests the required default scopes (`user-read-private user-read-email app-remote-control streaming user-modify-playback-state user-read-playback-state user-read-currently-playing`) and uses `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` as the callback URI.
steps.agentAssist: Can verify the auth configuration payload matches the required Spotify parameters.

requirements.detail: App owners and all test users must hold an active Spotify Premium subscription in Development Mode.
Required to log in and create a developer app to obtain Client ID and Client Secret.
Must explicitly register callback URLs (e.g., https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add) in the app settings.
Mandatory eligibility criteria to apply for Extended Quota Mode production access.

scopes.purpose: Access subscriber subscription details and profile information.
Control playback on a Spotify client and stream music.
Control playback on the user's Spotify account (play, pause, skip).
Read the user's current playback state and active device.
Read what track is currently playing on the user's account.

blockers.title: Exceeding the 5 User Development Cap
blockers.symptom: Test users receive 403 errors when attempting to authenticate outside the allowlist.
blockers.howToProceed: Manually add all test users under the User Management tab in the Spotify Developer Dashboard while in Development Mode.

blockers.title: Commercial Scaling Rejected due to MAU Rule
blockers.symptom: Extended quota requests or partner applications rejected for applications under 250k MAUs.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure your service meets the minimum 250,000 monthly active users threshold and is an established business entity before applying.

blockers.title: Non-Premium Account Authentication Failure
blockers.symptom: Authentication fails or returns access errors when non-Premium accounts attempt API interactions.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure all developers and test users hold an active Spotify Premium subscription during Development Mode.

blockers.title: Rate Limit Exceeded (QUOTA_EXCEEDED)
blockers.symptom: API requests return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
blockers.howToProceed: Implement exponential backoff and respect rate limit buckets as documented in Spotify's rate limit guidelines.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes
nuances.detail: Spotify access tokens typically expire in 1 hour (3600 seconds) and must be refreshed using the provided refresh token.

nuances.title: PKCE and Flow Support
nuances.detail: Spotify supports both Authorization Code Flow (with Client Secret for server-side apps) and Authorization Code with PKCE for public clients.

nuances.title: Redirect URI Strictness
nuances.detail: Redirect URIs must match registered values exactly; trailing slashes or path mismatches cause immediate authorization rejections.

nuances.title: Development Mode Client ID Limit
nuances.detail: Developers are strictly limited to 1 Development Mode Client ID per developer account.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and select the Spotify toolkit.
Create a custom OAuth2 auth config by inputting your Spotify Client ID and Client Secret.
Verify the redirect URI is set to https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback or https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add.
Confirm the default scopes (user-read-private, user-read-email, streaming, user-modify-playback-state, user-read-playback-state, user-read-currently-playing) are attached to your auth config.
Initiate an authentication flow via Composio to bind your Spotify account.
